components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per area: Processar, Atualizar, Fazer figura.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined companion action: Baixar CSV, Recalcular, Copiar figura.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif);padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent,#1a4e8a);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border-strong,#c9d3e0);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--accent-soft,#e9f1fa);border-color:var(--accent,#1a4e8a)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(26,78,138,.2)}

components.name: Dashed Add Button

components.name: Labelled Field
components.description: Label above, 30px field; focus turns the border blue with a washed ring.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#64748b);width:160px}.ds-input{height:30px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--text,#16212e);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--field-border,#8593a6);border-radius:7px;transition:border-color .12s,box-shadow .12s}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent,#1a4e8a);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(26,78,138,.14)}

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Segmented control for the three workspaces; the active tab is a white pill with blue text.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-on">Séries temporais</button><button class="ds-tab">Espectros</button><button class="ds-tab">Figura</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;background:var(--bg,#eef1f5);border:1px solid var(--border,#e2e7ee);border-radius:9px;padding:3px}.ds-tab{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif);padding:6px 18px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#64748b);border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s,background .15s}.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--text,#16212e)}.ds-tab.ds-on{background:#fff;color:var(--accent,#1a4e8a);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(26,78,138,.2)}

components.name: Step Card with Switch
components.description: A sidebar card: title, state summary, switch; the border tints blue when the step is on.
components.html: Savitzky-Golayjanela 21 · ordem 3
components.css: .ds-card{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif);width:300px;border:1px solid rgba(26,78,138,.35);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 13px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06)}.ds-card-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.ds-card-title{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text,#16212e)}.ds-card-state{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#64748b)}.ds-switch{width:34px;height:19px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--border-strong,#c9d3e0);position:relative;flex:0 0 34px;transition:background .18s}.ds-switch::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:left .18s}.ds-switch-on{background:var(--accent,#1a4e8a)}.ds-switch-on::after{left:17px}

components.description: Signature plot mark: dashed λ ref line, pale search band and the ring on the tracked valley.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "A Bancada Organizada"** (the tidy bench)

BraggFlow is a working bench for one test at a time. Everything sits where the work needs it:

- a white sidebar of numbered sections follows the order of the job (files,   sensors, processing steps). It is one surface divided by hairlines, not a   stack of boxes; - the plot takes the rest of the screen; - the results sit in panels stacked under the plot.

Nothing floats free. Each card has a header that says its state even when it is closed, and a small blue dot marks every option that differs from the default.

The mood is soft and orderly. Cool neutrals form the room: a pale blue-grey ground behind white surfaces, with dark blue-black ink. One pen-ink blue does every job that needs attention:

- the active tab; - the primary button; - a switch that is on; - the focus ring.

Density is high but calm:

- body text is 13px; - labels and hints are 12px; - the sidebar is 350px wide; - figures are tabular everywhere, so numbers line up.

Long explanations fold into a "Como funciona ›" disclosure, so the hint you see is one line long. Shortcuts sit where they act, as small key caps.

Icons are drawn in one stroke (24 × 24, 2px, round caps) from a sprite in the page, never text glyphs. The header reads like a path, **BraggFlow / LMR demo**, with the project switcher beside the name. The status bar reads like an instrument: values in ink with their unit in faded ink, and the CSV's state in a pill at the end.

The character comes from the plots, not the chrome. The plots carry the domain's own marks:

- the reference wavelength as a dashed orange line; - the search window as a pale orange band; - the tracked valley as an orange ring; - the FWHM as dashed level lines; - events as dashed vertical lines.

Trouble is never hidden. A refused value is marked at its field, with the reason under it. A plot that no longer matches the options carries a "Desatualizado" badge instead of disappearing.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral room (Névoa de Laboratório ground, white surfaces) with one blue
Numbered sidebar sections in the order of the work, separated by hairlines,
Soft cards that rest on the ground with a hairline shadow and gently rounded
Plots fill the main area; results stack under the plot.
Text keeps its case: λ, nm and σ stay λ, nm and σ.
Errors at the field, stale plots marked, shortcuts visible.
Drawn icons in one stroke; the status bar as an instrument readout.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Pen-ink blue is the only colour the chrome uses for emphasis. If something needs to stand out and it is not an error or a warning, it is blue or it is bold.

rules.name: The Orange Is Data Rule
rules.body: Reference orange belongs to the plot: what the evolution follows and where it looked. Never use it for chrome, buttons or decoration.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: One family carries brand, labels, data and plots. Size and weight make the hierarchy; a second typeface is never needed.

rules.name: The Case Is Meaning Rule
rules.body: Text keeps the case it was written in. λ, Δλ, σ, t, nm and s change meaning in capitals. No label, header or summary is ever transformed to uppercase; hierarchy comes from weight, size and ink.

rules.name: The Ruled Sidebar Rule
rules.body: The sidebar is one surface divided by hairlines. Boxes, with border, radius and shadow, belong to the panels of the main area. A box inside the sidebar is a box inside a box.

rules.name: The Rest, Don't Float Rule
rules.body: A surface in the flow of the page gets the Pousada shadow at most. Lift is reserved for things that sit above the page: dialogs, the error notice and floating panels.

dos: **Do** keep pen-ink blue as the only emphasis colour in the chrome. Errors and warnings use their own state colours.
**Do** order sidebar sections as the work happens, numbered, and let every card header summarise its own state.
**Do** give in-flow surfaces the Pousada shadow at most. Keep the Elevada shadow for dialogs, the error notice and floating panels.
**Do** keep orange for what the evolution tracks and where it looked, on the plot.
**Do** use tabular figures for every number, so columns line up.
**Do** mark a refused value at its field with the reason under it, and badge the plot as stale instead of blanking it.
donts: **Don't** uppercase text that can carry a symbol or unit (The Case Is Meaning Rule).
**Don't** put essential information only in a `title` tooltip. Shortcuts, what a mode does, and what a delete keeps must be visible or reachable by keyboard.
**Don't** add a second accent colour to the chrome. New emphasis is blue, bold, or a state colour.
**Don't** set functional text below 11.5px, or labels and hints below 12px.
**Don't** leave a control without an accessible name. Fields in tables and repeated rows get one through `aria-label`.
**Don't** use text glyphs (▶ × ↶ ⭳ ›) as icons. Draw them from the sprite.
**Don't** box a block inside the sidebar (The Ruled Sidebar Rule).
